svg.title: InForge-AI
svg.desc: InForge-AI: eight pipeline agents turn a CSV or Excel file into analysis, models and a report. Animated illustration: ingest, clean, EDA, visualize, ML benchmark, insights, code and chat run in order; missing cells are repaired, a trend is drawn, candidate models are compared. At insights the LLM provider fails, a local fallback takes over, and the run still completes. FastAPI, WebSockets, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, React. Completes without an LLM provider.
svg.text: Eight agents turn a CSV or Excel file
into analysis, models and a report.
